messages:
matt: getting paged — prod latency + 502 spikes immediately after the 09:12 deploy to inference-runner. Saw a bunch of CrashLoopBackOffs during node drains. Anyone oncall?

incident-bot: @channel Pager duty: critical - service inference-runner experiencing >30% 5xxs in us-west-2. Trigger: error-rate-threshold. Paging oncall.

matt: sending logs from host-az1: 
```
E0321 09:13:41.123 pod_manager.go:214] pod inference-runner-7f9c8 crashed: liveness probe failed: HTTP GET /healthz timeout
kubectl describe shows termination message: preStop hook failed, container terminated with exit code 1
```

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T09:12Z started by ci/cd pipeline (sha: abc1234 -> release/2026-03-21). Canary 10% -> 100% in progress. No automatic rollback triggered.

aisha: I'm oncall, taking it. @matt can you paste the rollout status and HPA?

matt: here —
```
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/inference-runner
# shows progressing: 2/5 updated, 3/5 available
kubectl -n prod get hpa inference-runner -o yaml
# minReplicas: 0  maxReplicas: 20  targetCPU: 30%
```

elaine: oh — HPA minReplicas set to 0 by the new manifest. That combined with our drain script is a bad combo: nodes get drained, kubelet sees low cpu and HPA scales to 0 during rolling update window.

sam: confirmed on my laptop — I can reproduce locally with `minReplicas: 0` + short terminationGracePeriod: pods get killed before new ones spin up and readiness/liveness probes start failing -> CrashLoop backoffs.

cs-ryan: we're getting customer reports from two enterprise tenants that API requests are returning 502/timeouts. Not a wholesale outage but definitely impacting SLA. Escalating to CS.

sre_lead: prioritize mitigation: 1) stop the rollout 2) enforce quick kill-switch (feature flag off) 3) set HPA minReplicas to 2 4) rollback if needed.

matt: attempting to pause the rollout — `kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/inference-runner`

deploy-bot: pause accepted for deployment/inference-runner at 09:21Z (ci/cd).

aisha: I'm toggling the feature flag for new-liquid-routing off (it gates the new sidecar behavior). Notifying deploy team.

elaine: doing HPA patch now — `kubectl -n prod patch hpa inference-runner -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'` -> patch applied. Requesting cluster to spin up new pods.

matt: starting manual scale to get capacity back: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment/inference-runner --replicas=6`

sam: while we do that, I'm cordoning the nodes that are mid-drain to avoid further evictions: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-1-37` and `kubectl get nodes | grep NotReady` to catch flappers.

incident-bot: oncall handoff reminder: @aisha please update the incident chair if this crosses >1h.

cs-ryan: received confirmation from 2 tenants that errors reduced after 09:28. Will continue to monitor and update customers.

deploy-bot: deploy controller: canary paused at 10% -> pending manual resume. SHA abc1234 still in canary.

matt: seeing new pods become Ready at 09:29 — good. CrashLoopBackOff count dropping.

sam: because pause is in place and feature flag toggled off, we should be safe to either fix manifest and resume or rollback. What's the deploy owner preference?

elaine: quick fix is to update chart: set minReplicas: 2 and bump terminationGracePeriod to 30s, remove the preStop race. But that's a code change — might be slower. I'd prefer rollback to the previous replicaset to be safe for customers.

deploy-bot: initiating rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-runner --to-revision=4` at 09:35Z (triggered by @aisha).

matt: rollback started. kubectl rollout status shows all pods from previous RS coming back. 5/5 available at 09:41.

cs-ryan: customer update: "we saw elevated 5xxs for ~15 minutes post-deploy, issue reduced after rollback. Thank you." Keeping CS channel posted.

incident-bot: severity update: currently degraded -> mitigated. Impact: partial for some tenants, errors peaked ~30% 5xx on inference-runner; no data loss.

aisha: summarizing mitigations for postmortem notes: 
- Paused canary immediately
- Toggled feature flag 'new-liquid-routing' OFF
- Patched HPA minReplicas to 2
- Scaled deployment manually to restore capacity
- Cordoned flapping nodes during stabilization
- Rolled back to previous replicaset

sam: adding root cause hypothesis: new sidecar + chart change set minReplicas:0 caused a race during node drain; terminationGracePeriod reduction in new image exacerbated preStop timing -> readiness probes triggered before app init -> CrashLoopBackOff.

elaine: action items (owners): 
- infra: add CI check to prevent minReplicas=0 in production charts (owner: sam)
- runtime: add guard in deployer to refuse rollout if HPA min < 1 (owner: matt)
- dev: revert preStop behavior and add integration test for drain scenarios (owner: app-team)
- ops: add a short runbook entry for cordon + HPA quick patch (owner: aisha)

sre_lead: evening oncall, @sam please take over monitoring for the next 4 hours. I'll draft the postmortem template.

aisha: handing off to @sam now. I'll remain reachable. Closing the active page.

sam: taking over. I'll post an incident summary and link to logs/artifacts.

incident-bot: incident resolved at 10:02Z. Incident duration ~50m. Please follow the post-incident checklist and add retrospective notes.

matt: thanks everyone. Noting we should re-run deploy once chart fix and CI guard are in place.

elaine: filing a postmortem draft now and pinging app-team for the code fix.

cs-ryan: closing customer loop: sent follow-up email confirming rollback and fixes-in-progress.

sam: will keep watch and escalate if anything flares up.

elaine: <@sre_lead> do you want to take this to SEV review tomorrow at 10:00?

sre_lead: yes, adding to calendar.

matt: closing thread. Good job all. :clap:
